verdict.rationale: Smithery explicitly hosts MCP servers and provides remote connection URLs that clients connect to without deploying infrastructure, handling OAuth, token refresh, and credential storage automatically; servers get dedicated pages, deep links, and typed SDKs for connecting from any client. Community evidence confirms real hosted servers (Context7, Brave Search, Google Sheets) are reachable this way, though it also surfaces security concerns in some hosted server tool descriptions, which is a quality/trust caveat rather than a functional failure of the reach-without-deploying story. Missing for 10: independent hands-on confirmation of zero-infrastructure setup from a client's perspective and clearer resolution of the security findings' impact on reliability.
